# DedSec Project — official bilingual website and learning library

> DedSec Project provides a free Android/Termux and Linux toolkit, documentation, programming lessons, troubleshooting, and defensive security education. Public toolkit: https://github.com/dedsec1121fk/DedSec. Ethical and authorized use only.


## Website pages / Σελίδες ιστοσελίδας


### DedSec Linux venv & Paths [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Assistance/dedsec-linux-venv-paths.html

DedSec Linux venv & Paths

Understand the Linux environment and file locations DedSec uses so you can troubleshoot without editing the wrong folders.

Quick Summary

Understand the Linux environment and file locations DedSec uses so you can troubleshoot without editing the wrong folders.

Project Environment

Desktop Linux uses a local .venv inside the DedSec repository. Run ./Run.sh instead of manually mixing global Python packages with the project.

Check The Environment

cd ~/DedSec pwd ./.venv/bin/python --version printf "%s\n" "$PATH"

Compatibility Layer

Compat/bin provides desktop-safe replacements or shims for commands expected by portable scripts. Run.sh adds it automatically.

Downloads

Portable tools normally save under ~/Downloads/ on Ubuntu, Kali Linux, and Linux Mint. Exact per-tool paths are listed on the Learn About The Tools page.

Shell Files

Ubuntu and Linux Mint commonly use ~/.bashrc. Kali may use ~/.zshrc. Termux uses $PREFIX/etc/bash.bashrc.

Next Steps

For platform-specific save paths, use Learn About The Tools. For other setup or runtime problems, return to Assistance.

### Fix Broken DedSec Install [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Assistance/fix-dedsec-broken-install.html

Fix Broken DedSec Install

Diagnose a DedSec Project install on Termux or supported Linux desktops when modules, paths, updates, environments, or storage stop working.

Quick Answer

Diagnose a DedSec Project install that stopped working after missing modules, wrong folders, failed updates, or storage problems.

Use this guide only when your symptom or goal matches the indicators below. If a diagnostic command reveals a different problem, follow that evidence instead of forcing every remaining step.

Last reviewed: July 24, 2026.

Use This Guide When

BrokenDedSecInstall

Before You Run Anything

Back up personal settings, outputs, modified scripts, and saved data before reinstalling or updating.

Confirm the exact DedSec folder and current Git state instead of cloning another nested copy.

Preserve the full first error rather than replacing the entire installation immediately.

Diagnostic Or Setup Commands

Back up personal DedSec settings and outputs first. Confirm the current DedSec folder before copying or running the block.

Copy commands

pwd ls python -m py_compile script.py python script.py

What The Commands Tell You

`pwd` — Prints the current working directory.

`ls` — Lists files, names, and permissions.

`python -m py_compile script.py` — Checks Python syntax without starting the complete program.

What Success Looks Like

The intended DedSec launcher starts from the documented folder.

Personal settings and saved output remain present after the repair or update.

A second launch works without repeating installation steps.

Safe Next Steps

Identify whether the failure is a folder, dependency, Git, permission, or saved-data problem.

Repair only that layer and run the smallest DedSec entry-point test.

Compare changed files before replacing local modifications.

Keep a dated backup after confirming the repaired version starts correctly.

Common Mistakes

Deleting the existing DedSec folder before copying personal settings and outputs.

Creating repeated nested clones such as `DedSec/DedSec/DedSec`.

Running a replacement command from the wrong language or project folder.

Still Stuck?

Copy the support report, fill in the missing values, and include the complete terminal output. Remove passwords, tokens, private keys, exact home paths, and personal information.

Fixed This Error But Want A Repeatable Way To Diagnose The Next One?

The Complete Termux Troubleshooting Handbook gives you a structured diagnostic process for Termux, Python, Git, storage, packages, networking and recovery instead of relying on disconnected fixes.

### Repair DedSec Linux Setup [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Assistance/fix-dedsec-linux-setup.html

Repair DedSec Linux Setup

Repair the desktop environment without deleting the whole project or touching unrelated system Python packages.

Quick Summary

Repair the desktop environment without deleting the whole project or touching unrelated system Python packages.

Check Required Packages

sudo apt update sudo apt install -y git python3 python3-venv python3-pip

Rebuild Only The Project Environment

cd ~/DedSec rm -rf .venv bash Setup.sh --update-only ./Run.sh

The rm -rf command above targets only the DedSec project's local .venv. Confirm you are inside the DedSec directory first.

If Your Clone Is Elsewhere

Use the actual clone path instead of ~/DedSec. Run pwd and git status before changing files.

Android-Specific Tools

Do not try to repair Termux-only utilities as Linux services. Android App Launcher, Mobile Desktop, Termux Backup/Restore, Termux Repair Wizard, and Mobile Developer Setup are intentionally not applicable on desktop Linux.

Next Steps

For platform-specific save paths, use Learn About The Tools. For other setup or runtime problems, return to Assistance.

### GitHub SSH/Auth [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Assistance/fix-github-ssh-authentication-termux.html

GitHub SSH/Auth

Set up GitHub authentication in Termux using HTTPS tokens or SSH keys without confusing it with normal passwords.

Quick Answer

Set up GitHub authentication in Termux using HTTPS tokens or SSH keys without confusing it with normal passwords.

Use this guide only when your symptom or goal matches the indicators below. If a diagnostic command reveals a different problem, follow that evidence instead of forcing every remaining step.

Last reviewed: July 24, 2026.

Use This Guide When

Permission denied (publickey)Host key verification failedAuthentication failed

Before You Run Anything

Run `git status`, `git branch --show-current`, and `git remote -v` inside the intended repository.

Back up uncommitted files before rebasing, amending, resetting, or rewriting history.

Remove tokens, private keys, and personal paths from any output you share.

Diagnostic Or Setup Commands

Run these commands only inside the intended repository. Review `git status` before every command that changes tracked files or history.

Copy commands

pkg install openssh git -y ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com" cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub ssh -T git@github.com

What The Commands Tell You

`pkg install openssh git -y` — Installs the listed Termux packages and dependencies.

What Success Looks Like

`git status` shows the expected branch and no unresolved conflicts.

The configured remote points to the intended repository and authentication succeeds without exposing credentials.

The pushed commit contains only the files you expected.

Safe Next Steps

Confirm the repository, branch, remote, and working-tree state.

Use the least destructive action that addresses the exact Git message.

Review the diff and staged files before committing or pushing.

Verify the result on GitHub after the push completes.

Common Mistakes

Running Git commands one folder above or below the intended repository.

Using force push, reset, or history rewriting before creating a verified backup.

Putting access tokens directly into commands, screenshots, README files, or public logs.

Still Stuck?

Copy the support report, fill in the missing values, and include the complete terminal output. Remove passwords, tokens, private keys, exact home paths, and personal information.

### Fix Localhost Server Not Opening On Android [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Assistance/fix-localhost-server-not-opening-android.html

Fix Localhost Server Not Opening On Android

Fix local server browser problems in Termux by checking host binding, port, folder, firewall-like Android behavior, and correct URL.

Quick Answer

Fix local server browser problems in Termux by checking host binding, port, folder, firewall-like Android behavior, and correct URL.

Use this guide only when your symptom or goal matches the indicators below. If a diagnostic command reveals a different problem, follow that evidence instead of forcing every remaining step.

Last reviewed: July 24, 2026.

Use This Guide When

Connection refusedThis site can’t be reachedERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED

Before You Run Anything

Start the server in the foreground and keep its terminal output visible.

Confirm the exact host, port, serving folder, and URL before opening the browser.

Expose only a dedicated public folder; never expose the Termux home folder, keys, backups, or private repositories.

Diagnostic Or Setup Commands

Replace the example port and folder. Test the local URL on the same phone before creating a LAN address or public tunnel.

Copy commands

pwd python -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 # open http://127.0.0.1:8080 in the same phone browser

What The Commands Tell You

`pwd` — Prints the current working directory.

`python -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1` — Starts a simple local HTTP server in the current folder.

What Success Looks Like

The local URL opens on the same phone and the terminal logs the request.

Refreshing the page serves the current files rather than stale cached content.

Stopping the server releases the port and removes any temporary public tunnel.

Safe Next Steps

Verify the serving process and folder locally before changing browser or tunnel settings.

Check whether another process already owns the port.

Use `127.0.0.1` for same-phone testing and an intentional bind address for LAN testing.

Create a public tunnel only after the local URL works and remove secrets from the served folder.

Common Mistakes

Opening the wrong port or assuming `localhost` on another device points to the phone.

Starting several background servers without tracking their process IDs.

Publishing credentials, source repositories, backups, or the complete Termux home through a tunnel.

Still Stuck?

Copy the support report, fill in the missing values, and include the complete terminal output. Remove passwords, tokens, private keys, exact home paths, and personal information.

Turn This Fix Into A Repeatable Website Workflow

If you are building or publishing sites from your phone, the Build and Publish Website with AI guide connects HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Git, GitHub Pages, testing, rollback and mobile QA into one controlled process.

### Node/npm Errors [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Assistance/fix-node-npm-errors-termux.html

Node/npm Errors

Fix npm command not found, node-gyp build errors, package install failures, and broken JavaScript projects in Termux.

Quick Answer

Fix npm command not found, node-gyp build errors, package install failures, and broken JavaScript projects in Termux.

Use this guide only when your symptom or goal matches the indicators below. If a diagnostic command reveals a different problem, follow that evidence instead of forcing every remaining step.

Last reviewed: July 24, 2026.

Use This Guide When

npm ERR!node-gypERESOLVEMODULE_NOT_FOUND

Before You Run Anything

Copy the complete error, including the first package, file, module, or line number it names.

Record `termux-info`, the active language/runtime version, and the current folder before changing dependencies.

Do not delete package-manager locks or upgrade pip itself through pip in Termux.

Diagnostic Or Setup Commands

Keep `package-lock.json` unless dependency versions must intentionally change. Use `npm ci` when the lock file is valid.

Copy commands

pkg update pkg install -y nodejs python make clang node -v npm -v npm cache verify test -f package-lock.json && npm ci || npm install

What The Commands Tell You

`pkg update` — Refreshes the Termux package index.

`pkg install -y nodejs python make clang` — Installs the listed Termux packages and dependencies.

`npm cache verify` — Checks npm cache without deleting the dependency lock file.

What Success Looks Like

The minimal version, import, syntax, path, or package test exits successfully.

The original command now fails later for a different, clearly identified reason or completes normally.

The package manager has no interrupted configuration left pending.

Safe Next Steps

Repair or update the Termux package layer before retrying a language package.

Confirm that the interpreter and its package tool belong to the same installation.

Install the missing system dependency before repeating a Python or Node build.

Retest with a minimal version, import, compile, or file command before running the full script.

Common Mistakes

Using `sudo`, Ubuntu package names, or desktop paths in a normal Termux installation.

Assuming that a Python import name always matches the distribution name on PyPI.

Deleting caches, environments, or lock files before preserving the exact error and versions.

Still Stuck?

Copy the support report, fill in the missing values, and include the complete terminal output. Remove passwords, tokens, private keys, exact home paths, and personal information.

Do not delete package-manager locks or upgrade pip itself through pip in Termux.

Diagnostic Or Setup Commands

Termux manages pip through the `python-pip` package. Do not run `pip install --upgrade pip`; update it with `pkg upgrade python-pip`.

Copy commands

pkg update pkg install -y python python-pip python -m pip --version python -m pip install --upgrade setuptools wheel python -m pip install PACKAGE_NAME

What The Commands Tell You

`pkg update` — Refreshes the Termux package index.

`pkg install -y python python-pip` — Installs the listed Termux packages and dependencies.

`python -m pip --version` — Shows which pip belongs to the active Python.

`python -m pip install --upgrade setuptools wheel` — Installs or updates the named Python distribution, not pip itself.

What Success Looks Like

The minimal version, import, syntax, path, or package test exits successfully.

The original command now fails later for a different, clearly identified reason or completes normally.

The package manager has no interrupted configuration left pending.

Safe Next Steps

Repair or update the Termux package layer before retrying a language package.

Confirm that the interpreter and its package tool belong to the same installation.

Install the missing system dependency before repeating a Python or Node build.

Retest with a minimal version, import, compile, or file command before running the full script.

Common Mistakes

Using `sudo`, Ubuntu package names, or desktop paths in a normal Termux installation.

Assuming that a Python import name always matches the distribution name on PyPI.

Deleting caches, environments, or lock files before preserving the exact error and versions.

Still Stuck?

Copy the support report, fill in the missing values, and include the complete terminal output. Remove passwords, tokens, private keys, exact home paths, and personal information.

Diagnostic Or Setup Commands

The PyPI distribution name can differ from the import name—for example, `beautifulsoup4` is imported as `bs4`.

Copy commands

python - <<'PYCODE' import sys print("Python:", sys.executable) print("Version:", sys.version) PYCODE python -m pip show DISTRIBUTION_NAME python -m pip install DISTRIBUTION_NAME python -c "import IMPORT_NAME; print('import ok')"

What The Commands Tell You

`python - <<'PYCODE'` — Runs an inline Python diagnostic.

`python -m pip show DISTRIBUTION_NAME` — Checks whether a Python distribution is installed.

`python -m pip install DISTRIBUTION_NAME` — Installs or updates the named Python distribution, not pip itself.

`python -c "import IMPORT_NAME; print('import ok')"` — Runs a small isolated Python test.

What Success Looks Like

The minimal version, import, syntax, path, or package test exits successfully.

The original command now fails later for a different, clearly identified reason or completes normally.

The package manager has no interrupted configuration left pending.

Safe Next Steps

Repair or update the Termux package layer before retrying a language package.

Confirm that the interpreter and its package tool belong to the same installation.

Install the missing system dependency before repeating a Python or Node build.

Retest with a minimal version, import, compile, or file command before running the full script.

Common Mistakes

Using `sudo`, Ubuntu package names, or desktop paths in a normal Termux installation.

Assuming that a Python import name always matches the distribution name on PyPI.

Deleting caches, environments, or lock files before preserving the exact error and versions.

Still Stuck?

Copy the support report, fill in the missing values, and include the complete terminal output. Remove passwords, tokens, private keys, exact home paths, and personal information.

### Check Broken Links And SEO Basics Locally From Termux [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Assistance/termux-check-broken-links-locally.html

Check Broken Links And SEO Basics Locally From Termux

Scan local HTML files for broken internal links, missing titles, missing meta descriptions, bad canonicals, and sitemap problems from a phone.

Quick Answer

Scan local HTML files for broken internal links, missing titles, missing meta descriptions, bad canonicals, and sitemap problems from a phone.

Use this guide only when your symptom or goal matches the indicators below. If a diagnostic command reveals a different problem, follow that evidence instead of forcing every remaining step.

Last reviewed: July 24, 2026.

Use This Guide When

CheckBrokenLinksBasics

Before You Run Anything

Create a dated backup and verify that it contains the files required for recovery.

Preview the current state with listing, status, size, or dry-run commands before changing it.

Keep generated output, cache, secrets, and source files separated.

Diagnostic Or Setup Commands

This checker validates local targets and core SEO tags. It intentionally does not request external URLs.

Copy commands

pkg install -y python python -m pip install beautifulsoup4 python - <<'PYCODE' from pathlib import Path from urllib.parse import unquote, urlsplit from bs4 import BeautifulSoup

root = Path('.').resolve() problems = [] for page in root.rglob('*.html'): soup = BeautifulSoup(page.read_text(encoding='utf-8', errors='replace'), 'html.parser') if not soup.title or not soup.title.get_text(strip=True): problems.append((page, 'missing <title>')) if not soup.find('meta', attrs={'name': 'description'}): problems.append((page, 'missing meta description')) if not soup.find('link', rel='canonical'): problems.append((page, 'missing canonical')) for tag, attr in [('a','href'),('img','src'),('script','src'),('link','href')]: for node in soup.find_all(tag): raw = (node.get(attr) or '').strip() if not raw or raw.startswith(('#','mailto:','tel:','data:','javascript:')): continue parsed = urlsplit(raw) if parsed.scheme or parsed.netloc: continue target = unquote(parsed.path) candidate = (root / target.lstrip('/')) if target.startswith('/') else (page.parent / target) if target.endswith('/'): candidate = candidate / 'index.html' if not candidate.resolve().exists(): problems.append((page, f'broken {attr}: {raw}')) for page, issue in problems: print(f'{page}: {issue}') print(f'Problems: {len(problems)}') PYCODE

What The Commands Tell You

`pkg install -y python` — Installs the listed Termux packages and dependencies.

`python -m pip install beautifulsoup4` — Installs or updates the named Python distribution, not pip itself.

`python - <<'PYCODE'` — Runs an inline Python diagnostic.

What Success Looks Like

The workflow can be repeated without overwriting the previous backup or losing current work.

The result can be verified with a simple list, diff, status, checksum, or test command.

A documented rollback restores the previous state when the new result is wrong.

Share Local Termux Links Safely With Cloudflared Or QR Codes

Understand local links, phone browser testing, Cloudflared tunnels, QR sharing, and safe limits for temporary Termux servers.

Understand local links, phone browser testing, Cloudflared tunnels, QR sharing, and safe limits for temporary Termux servers.

ShareLocalTermuxLinks

Before You Run Anything

Diagnostic Or Setup Commands

Quick Tunnels are temporary testing links. Do not expose your Termux home, credentials, private repositories, or backups.

Copy commands

pkg install -y cloudflared python mkdir -p ~/PublicShare && cd ~/PublicShare python -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 # In a second Termux session: cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:8080

What The Commands Tell You

`pkg install -y cloudflared python` — Installs the listed Termux packages and dependencies.

`python -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1` — Starts a simple local HTTP server in the current folder.

`cloudflared tunnel --url http://127.0.0.1:8080` — Creates a temporary public tunnel to a working local service.

What Success Looks Like

The local URL opens on the same phone and the terminal logs the request.

Refreshing the page serves the current files rather than stale cached content.

Safe Next Steps

Check whether another process already owns the port.

Use `127.0.0.1` for same-phone testing and an intentional bind address for LAN testing.

Create a public tunnel only after the local URL works and remove secrets from the served folder.

Common Mistakes

Opening the wrong port or assuming `localhost` on another device points to the phone.

Starting several background servers without tracking their process IDs.

Publishing credentials, source repositories, backups, or the complete Termux home through a tunnel.

### Founder's Story & Project's Vision [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Pages/about-founder.html

Founder's Story & Project's Vision

The story behind DedSec Project and the vision that grew from it — together in one place.

Founded October 20, 2024 · Available for Android (Termux), Ubuntu, Kali Linux and Linux Mint

From Curiosity About Digital Worlds To A Real Project Built From A Phone

Where It Started

My name is Loukas Floros. I was born on 14 August 2004, and I created DedSec Project as a practical learning project for people who want to understand Termux, Android, programming, cybersecurity, and useful phone-first workflows.

I created DedSec Project on October 20, 2024. What began as a phone-first learning effort expanded to support Android through Termux and Linux environments including Ubuntu, Kali Linux and Linux Mint. Each platform has its own setup instructions and prerequisites.

The Watch Dogs games first made me curious about technology, privacy, connected systems, and the power that digital tools can have in everyday life. That curiosity pushed me to start learning programming and experimenting with Termux and Android instead of leaving the idea inside a fictional world.

What It Became

DedSec Project grew from that learning path. It is not presented as a finished answer to everything. It is a continuously improving collection of tools, lessons, guides, experiments, and troubleshooting material designed to help other people learn by doing and understand what they run.

The project is independent and focused on education, lawful experimentation, practical problem solving, privacy awareness, and making useful technical knowledge more approachable from an Android phone.

Project's Vision

DedSec Project is built around a simple idea: useful technology should help people understand more, depend less on black boxes, and have meaningful control over the devices and tools they use. The project aims to turn curiosity into practical ability — especially for people learning directly from an Android phone.

Practical Learning

Learning should go beyond reading commands. DedSec Project focuses on real examples, troubleshooting, repeatable workflows, and explanations that help users understand what a tool is doing before they rely on it.

Technology Within Reach

A phone can be more than a consumption device. The project is designed to show that useful technical learning, scripting, experimentation, and problem solving can begin with hardware people already own, without requiring an expensive setup first.

Control, Privacy & Transparency

Users should be able to understand what runs on their devices, make informed choices, protect their privacy, and keep reasonable control over software they install and systems they own. Security should increase confidence without unnecessarily removing openness or user choice.

Open, Free Core That Keeps Evolving

The core project should remain freely available and continue improving through new lessons, tools, fixes, documentation, and community feedback. Optional paid guides and clearly scoped adaptations can support that work, but they should complement the free project rather than replace it.

The long-term direction is simple: make technical knowledge easier to reach, easier to understand, and more useful in everyday life while keeping learning responsible, independent, and grounded in what people can actually do with their own devices.

Why DedSec Project Matters in a Changing World

This is my perspective on technology, freedom, economic pressure, and the reasons behind this independent project. These are concerns to examine critically, not claims that every institution or new technology is harmful.

Technology: Progress and Danger

Technology has evolved from simple personal tools into connected systems capable of learning, monitoring, predicting, and influencing behavior. AI, automated decisions, digital tracking, and cyberattacks can make life easier, but when abused or left without safeguards, their power can also become dangerous. People deserve understandable tools, privacy, and the skills to question what technology does.

Poverty and a Growing Digital Divide

In many places, rising living costs and unequal access to opportunity make people feel poorer even as technology advances. Paid services, expensive hardware, and limited access to training can widen that gap. DedSec Project aims to keep a useful learning path accessible to people who may only have a phone and the determination to learn.

Power, Government and Corruption

Governments and powerful organizations are not immune to corruption, secrecy, or the misuse of surveillance. That risk grows when decisions are opaque and ordinary people cannot ask questions or hold institutions accountable. My response is to support lawful research, transparency, digital literacy, and independent scrutiny—not to assume everyone in government is corrupt.

Could Physical Cash Disappear?

As contactless payments, banking apps, and cashless services expand, I worry about a future where physical cash becomes difficult or impossible to use. Cash still matters for privacy, resilience during outages, accessibility, and people who are excluded from digital banking. Digital payments can be useful, but I believe people should retain a real choice.

Learn, Adapt and Stay Independent

The answer is not to reject progress but to understand it. DedSec Project encourages ethical cybersecurity education, practical programming, local-first tools, thoughtful security practices, and informed choices. Knowledge helps people participate in the digital world instead of being powerless inside it.

Due Process, Legal Counsel, And Public Scrutiny

If any DedSec Project member, contributor, or person publicly associated with the project is detained or arrested, their fundamental rights must be respected. A detention is not automatically unlawful merely because a lawyer is not physically present at the moment of arrest, and the exact rules differ by jurisdiction. In the European Union, suspects must be given access to a lawyer without undue delay and, in principle, before police questioning, subject only to limited legal exceptions.

Every such case deserves calm, independent, evidence-based scrutiny. The public and the press should examine the stated charges, court records, treatment in custody, access to counsel, and whether due process was followed. No one should obstruct an investigation, threaten officials, expose private information, or decide guilt or innocence from headlines alone.

Security research, digital protest, and hacktivism can be politically sensitive, misunderstood, or portrayed selectively. That makes transparency and independent review especially important, but association with DedSec Project never creates immunity from a lawful investigation. The project supports legal, ethical, authorized activity, the presumption of innocence, and the right of every accused person to prepare a defence.

Rights references: EU Directive 2013/48/EU · EU Charter, Article 48.

Public Work Survives When Support Exists

DedSec Project exists so people can learn, test, protect themselves, and build from a phone. Behind that public work are real costs for device testing, writing, translation, maintenance, and fixes. Optional GitHub sponsorship helps keep the public project moving; the $25 Ultimate Supporter tier also includes the current five-ebook library in English and Greek.

Keep Android Open

This principle is part of the project's wider vision: Android should remain a platform where users can choose how they use their own devices.

User Control

People should be able to install, remove, repair, and configure software on hardware they own.

Independent Development

Independent developers and alternative app distribution should remain viable parts of the Android ecosystem.

Privacy And Choice

Security improvements should not unnecessarily remove privacy, openness, or meaningful user choice.

### ButSystem.py [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Pages/butsystem-exclusive.html

ButSystem.py

ButSystem.py is a self-hosted, local-first private workspace for Termux that combines private communication, encrypted records, an advanced file vault, news and weather tools, and automatically generated local, Cloudflared, and Tor access links in one browser interface.

Exclusive to DedSec Project — included free

ButSystem is one of the project’s most distinctive all-in-one systems, built specifically for the DedSec Project ecosystem. Despite that exclusive positioning, the version documented here is available free through the project files and repository.

Core ButSystem Feature Areas

ButSystem.py brings chats, groups, stories, files, profiles, encrypted records, weather, news, security controls, admin tools, and flexible local or remote access together in one self-hosted interface.

Chats, Groups & Stories

Live direct messages, group chats, saved messages, GIFs, voice notes, file sharing, the discussion room, stories, and call flows where browser and device support allow it.

Security, Access & Control

User approval, device access requests, remembered-device login, optional security-question 2FA, chat PIN locks, online status, reports, admin pages, and appearance or account settings.

Profiles, Vault & Tools

Profile editing, an advanced private file vault, opt-in live locations, encrypted Profiler records with search, import, export, and combine tools, administrator bounty controls, and the built-in Face Detector.

Weather, Links & Sharing

Search weather by place or current location, view detailed forecasts for up to 14 days, and use generated HTTPS, Cloudflared, or Tor links with downloadable QR codes. Vault files can also be shared through controlled links with optional passwords, expiry, and revocation.

All Screens & Buttons (Complete)

Instead of a long button-by-button list, this section explains each ButSystem area the same way the Learn page explains tools: by feature area, what you do there, and what kind of controls you will find when you open it.

Navigation & Menu Flow

The burger menu is the main control hub of ButSystem. From there you move between chats, saved messages, discussion, groups, calls, stories, live locations, files, news, weather, profiles, Profiler, reports, notifications, admin pages, settings, help, and login or logout actions, while the language toggle keeps the interface available in both English and Greek.

Authentication & Access

ButSystem opens through its landing, loading, login, and signup flow, then adds extra access control where needed. That includes user approval, device access requests, remembered-device login, optional security-question two-factor checks, and password recovery or reset actions so access stays tied to approved users and approved devices.

Direct Messages

The DM area is built for day-to-day private conversation. You can open a chat, write and send text, edit or delete messages, search conversation content, attach media or files, use GIFs, record or play voice notes, and work with chat protections such as PIN locks and visible online status where those controls are enabled.

Discussion Room

Discussion works more like a shared stream than a one-to-one chat. It is the place for broader entries, category-based posting, search, refresh, loading more content, and opening a specific entry when you want a calmer shared space separate from normal DMs.

Groups

The Groups area lets users build shared spaces with roles and moderation controls. You can create a group, invite or add members, check the member list, manage owner or admin actions such as promote, demote, or remove, leave a group when needed, and continue the conversation through the related group chat with messages and attachments.

Calls & Live Communication

Where browser support and device permissions allow it, ButSystem includes call flows for starting, joining, accepting, denying, muting, and ending a live call. The exact experience depends on microphone permissions and the current browser environment, so the call layer is treated as a live feature area rather than a static page.

Stories & Live Locations

ButSystem also covers lighter live-sharing tools. Stories provide creation, viewing, and reaction controls, while Live Locations is reserved for opt-in location sharing with start, stop, refresh, and clear consent or warning prompts before location data is actively shared.

Files, Vault & Saved Media

The Files and Vault area works like a private server-style file manager. It supports folders and navigation, normal or chunked uploads with cancellation, search, categories, file-type filters, sorting, previews, opening and downloading, rename, move, bulk actions, deletion, comments, activity history, detailed size, MIME, and date metadata, optional SHA-256, and controlled share links with optional passwords, expiry times, and revocation.

Profile, Account & Appearance

Your own profile area handles identity and account presentation. From there users can view or edit profile data, save changes, upload or remove a profile picture, adjust account settings, control appearance options, and access stronger account actions such as account deletion or the self-destruct danger zone where that workflow is enabled.

Profiler, Bounty & Face Detector

The Profiler side is where ButSystem becomes a structured information workspace. It supports encrypted profiler entries, view and edit flows, local search, export and combine tools, bounty management where that module is enabled, and the built-in Face Detector area used for local face-detection workflows and similarity-style comparison support inside the broader ButSystem environment.

Reports, Admin & Security Settings

The control layer of ButSystem is split across reports, admin pages, and security settings. This is where users create or update reports, where admins approve or deny access and device requests, manage people and user files, and where account holders configure two-factor settings, device-login rules, password-reset paths, privacy options, and other safeguards that keep the workspace organized and controlled.

News & Topic Feed

The News area gives the workspace a dedicated place for topic-based updates without mixing them into private chats. Users can open the feed, move between available topics, refresh the current view, and read updates from the same local interface used for the rest of ButSystem.

Weather & Forecasts

Search by city, village, or postal code, use the device's current location, refresh results, and view current conditions plus forecasts for up to 14 days. The page can show current and apparent temperature, humidity, wind and gusts, precipitation, cloud cover, pressure, rain probability, UV, sunrise, and sunset. Coordinates are used for the request and are not saved by ButSystem.

Generated HTTPS, Cloudflared & Tor Links

At startup, ButSystem serves local HTTPS with a generated self-signed certificate, prints LAN and localhost URLs, and automatically attempts a Cloudflared quick tunnel and a Tor hidden service. The landing page displays whichever links are available and generates a fresh downloadable QR code for each one.

Presence, Delivery & Live State

ButSystem keeps active areas responsive with heartbeat-based online status, unread message counts, delivery and read state, polling for new direct or group messages, and live refresh paths for discussion, locations, calls, and other changing data. This makes the interface feel current without needing a separate desktop client.

Attachments, Previews & Large Uploads

Files are handled according to where they are used. Direct messages, groups, discussion, and stories support the relevant file, image, voice, or media attachments; profiles support profile pictures; and the vault adds previews, metadata, organization, sharing, and chunked transfer for larger uploads so they are not forced through one fragile request.

Local Data Protection & Persistence

Account records, settings, messages, encrypted text fields, keys, logs, and workspace data are kept in ButSystem's own local folders. The script prefers the phone's shared Homework storage when available so important app state can survive a Termux reinstall, while sensitive text and Profiler content use the built-in encryption layer.

Search, Export & Record Workflows

Several areas are designed for finding, filtering, and moving information instead of only displaying it. Users can search conversations, discussion entries, vault files, reports, and Profiler records; filter and sort the vault; open focused details; import, export, or combine Profiler records; and download attachments when a local copy is needed.

Privacy Pause, Logs & Recovery Controls

The system includes operational safeguards for moments when access must be stopped or reviewed. Privacy pause and resume actions can temporarily protect the workspace, security events are written to local logs, admins can inspect log files, and recovery tools cover forgotten passwords, approved devices, forced sign-out, account deletion, and full reset workflows.

Forgot The Password? Start ButSystem Fresh

Use this only when recovery is impossible and you accept losing every old ButSystem account, password, setting, message, vault file, key, and log. Stop ButSystem first, then run the reset command for your platform and start ButSystem.py again so it creates a completely fresh workspace.

Warning: these commands permanently delete the saved ButSystem data folders. They do not delete the ButSystem.py script itself.

Termux (Android)

Copyrm -rf "$HOME/storage/shared/Homework/ButSystem" "/storage/emulated/0/Homework/ButSystem" "$HOME/Homework/ButSystem" "$HOME/ButSystem" "$HOME/.ButSystem_tor"

Ubuntu

Copyrm -rf "$HOME/Homework/ButSystem" "$HOME/ButSystem" "$HOME/.ButSystem_tor"

Kali Linux

Copyrm -rf "$HOME/Homework/ButSystem" "$HOME/ButSystem" "$HOME/.ButSystem_tor"

Linux Mint

Copyrm -rf "$HOME/Homework/ButSystem" "$HOME/ButSystem" "$HOME/.ButSystem_tor"

### Frequently Asked Questions [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Pages/faq.html

Frequently Asked Questions

Answers to real questions about DedSec Project, its programs, installation, Assistance guides, safety, compatibility, updates, repositories, contributions and support.

Project Basics

What Is The DedSec Project?

DedSec Project is a phone-first Termux toolkit and website ecosystem for learning, organizing scripts, checking links/files, exploring OSINT awareness, and solving Android/Termux workflow problems in a legal and responsible way.

Who Created It?

DedSec Project was created by Loukas Floros. The About The Founder page explains how an interest in Watch Dogs, technology, privacy, Termux, and programming developed into the project.

Is DedSec Project Only For Programmers?

No. It is designed for people who want to learn Termux and solve real digital problems from an Android phone. Beginners should start from the Installation Guide, then Learn About The Tools, then Assistance.

Does It Require Root?

Most of the project is built for no-root Android usage through Termux. If a tool ever needs a special permission, it should explain it before use.

Website Navigation

Where Should A New User Start?

Start from the main page, open Guide For Installation, read Learn About The Tools, then use Assistance when you hit a specific Termux or DedSec problem.

What Is Assistance?

Assistance replaced the old assistant chat. It is a set of standalone SEO-friendly help pages for Termux setup, storage permission, Python modules, pip errors, GitHub clone, unzip, updates, and broken installs.

Why Is The FAQ Now Only About The Project?

Project questions stay here. Technical Termux troubleshooting moved to Assistance so each problem has its own focused page that users and search engines can understand better.

What Paid Options Are Currently Available?

Use Assistance for free focused fixes and the Termux handbook for a complete diagnostic process. GitHub Sponsors currently has $3 Sponsor, $9 Pro Supporter, and $25 Ultimate Supporter tiers; the $25 tier includes the current five-ebook library in English and Greek.

Tools, Safety & Use

Are The Tools Meant For Illegal Hacking?

No. The project should be used for learning, privacy awareness, authorized testing, diagnostics, and personal workflow improvement. Do not use any tool against systems or accounts you do not own or have permission to test.

Where Can I Learn What Each Tool Does?

Open Learn About The Tools. That page explains the tools and helps you decide what to run before you touch Termux commands.

What Is ButSystem.py?

ButSystem.py is a free, local-first, self-hosted workspace included in DedSec Project. It brings together chats, groups, stories, profiles, files, security controls, and temporary sharing links. Read its dedicated page for features, access settings, and safety guidance before installing or resetting it.

Is The Project Bilingual?

Yes. The website supports English and Greek with a language switcher, and new Assistance pages include both English and Greek text.

GitHub Sponsors & Ebook Library

Do I Have To Pay For ButSystem?

No. ButSystem is included free inside DedSec Project. Its dedicated page explains the included version and its features.

What Do The GitHub Sponsor Tiers Include?

The $3 monthly tier adds the GitHub sponsor badge, sponsor community access and the current basic private sponsor repository. The $9 Pro Supporter tier includes the $3 benefits plus the expanded private sponsor set. The $25 Ultimate Supporter tier includes everything in $9 plus all five current ebooks in English and Greek. Sponsorship billing is handled by GitHub.

View Sponsor Tiers

Which Ebooks Are Included In The $25 Tier?

The current $25 Ultimate Supporter library includes Data Analytics in Practice; Faith in the Digital Age; The Complete Termux Troubleshooting Handbook; Build and Publish a Website with AI from Your Phone; and AI Website Prompt Library and Release Workbook. The Learn About The Tools page gives a full description of each book.

Explore The Ebook Library

Installation And Compatibility

Which Termux Version Should I Use?

Use an official Termux release from F-Droid or the official GitHub releases. Google Play also has a separate experimental branch for Android 11 and later with different limitations. Check the official installation instructions and keep the app and its plugins from the same source.

Will DedSec Project Work Without Root?

Most DedSec Project scripts and the Assistance guides are designed for normal, non-rooted Android devices. Features that depend on protected Android areas, raw wireless interfaces or system-level modification may be unavailable without root.

Why Does A Package Or Python Module Fail To Install?

Common causes are an outdated Termux build, unfinished package upgrades, unsupported CPU wheels, low storage, broken repositories or a dependency that needs compilation. Use Assistance and include the complete error, Android version, architecture and command you ran.

Can I Use The Project On A Low-End Phone?

Yes for many scripts, lessons and local utilities. Large AI models, media processing, heavy scans and multiple servers can be slow or run out of memory. Start with lightweight options and keep free storage available.

Does The Installer Download Missing Requirements Automatically?

Many launchers check for common packages and Python modules, but not every Android, repository or compiler problem can be solved automatically. Read each prompt before accepting changes and keep a backup of personal modifications.

Can The Project Be Used Offline?

Downloaded local scripts and documentation can work offline. Features that query websites, APIs, repositories, maps, weather, public records or remote services require a connection.

Programs And Components

What Is Settings.py?

Settings.py is the central control panel for the DedSec Project and the launcher for DedSec OS. It manages updates, packages/modules, backups and offline transfer, Sponsors-Only access, prompt/GitHub/usage settings, HTTP Proxy & Tor utilities, menu style, auto-start and language; DedSec OS adds a browser-native desktop with movable/resizable windows, Start/taskbar/Action Center, File Explorer and shared Open/Save dialogs, Notepad, Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF tools, photo/video/media apps, Terminal, Software Center, personalization, login/optional 2FA/recovery, and Help & Troubleshooting with guided fixes and live diagnostics.

What Is Developer Base?

Developer Base groups phone-first utilities for files, coding, project structure, local websites, notes and development workflows inside Termux.

What Do File Converter.py And File Type Checker.py Do?

File Type Checker helps inspect the real type of a file instead of trusting only its extension. File Converter provides guided conversion workflows where supported. Always preserve originals before converting.

What Is Mobile Developer Setup.py?

Mobile Developer Setup.py builds a complete Termux developer workstation instead of only installing a few packages. It installs multiple language runtimes, compilers and build tools, databases, npm/Python developer utilities, Zsh/Oh My Zsh with Powerlevel10k, Termux UI settings and NvChad, and includes backup, update, repair, restore and uninstall workflows. Exact package availability can still depend on Android/Termux architecture and upstream repositories.

What Are The Network Tools For?

They support defensive learning, local diagnostics, link checks, QR creation, footprint awareness and authorized network observation. They are not permission to scan or interfere with systems you do not own.

What Is Personal Information Capture?

It is a high-risk training category demonstrating how social engineering and browser permission requests can expose data. Use it only in controlled demonstrations with explicit informed consent. Never deploy deceptive pages against real people.

What Are The Games Inside The Project?

The Games section contains local terminal and browser experiments such as Pet Friends, Tamagotchi, Terminal Arcade and other interactive projects. They demonstrate scripting, state, menus and creative coding on Android.

Assistance guides

Is Assistance guides Only A Website?

The website teaches the theory and gives structured instructions. Practical work runs locally through Termux and the included Assistance.py companion, which prepares safe workspaces and records progress on the device.

Where Are Local DedSec Files Stored?

Local project data and outputs stay in the paths documented for each tool. Platform-specific save paths are listed in Learn About The Tools.

Do The Practical Labs Touch My Real Files?

The companion creates separate training folders with supplied samples. A lesson may ask you to inspect your own phone settings, but it should clearly say so. Never point destructive commands at shared storage or personal folders.

Are Repair And Custom ROM Lessons Step-By-Step Flashing Instructions?

No universal procedure is safe for every model. The project documentation emphasizes model verification, documentation research, backups, risk assessment, dry runs and rollback planning. Follow the exact manufacturer or ROM maintainer guide for your exact model and region.

Can I Use DedSec Without Internet?

Many downloaded theory pages and local labs work offline. Research lessons, official-source verification, package installation and update checks require temporary internet access.

How Do I Resume A Practical Lab?

Use the Assistance pages for the problem you are working on, and keep backups before replacing or repairing project files.

Can A Lesson Estimate Take Longer Or Less Time?

Yes. Hours are estimates for active setup, testing, verification and documentation. Device speed, experience, troubleshooting and the depth of your evidence can change the real duration.

Security, Privacy And Legal Boundaries

Does The Website Collect Information About Visitors?

The site may use Google Tag Manager and analytics for visits, clicks, device information and approximate region-level statistics, as explained in the Privacy Policy. Website analytics are separate from DedSec Project files stored on your device.

Does DedSec Project Secretly Upload My Files?

The public project should be reviewed like any other source code. Do not enter secrets into scripts you have not inspected. Network-enabled tools should state why they connect, and you should test them with non-sensitive samples first.

Can I Use Fake Pages Or Capture Tools On Another Person?

Only with explicit informed consent in a controlled training environment. Deception, credential collection, camera or microphone capture and location collection without authorization can be illegal and harmful.

Does An Antivirus Warning Automatically Mean A Script Is Malware?

Not automatically, especially for security tools, local servers or obfuscated samples, but warnings must not be ignored. Inspect the source, permissions, network behavior and files changed before deciding whether to run it.

What Should Happen If A Contributor Faces Legal Action?

Their rights, access to legal counsel, presumption of innocence and due process should be respected. Public discussion should rely on verified records and must not obstruct investigations, threaten people or assume guilt from headlines.

Repositories, Updates And Contributions

What Is The Difference Between The Main And Backup Websites?

The main website is ded-sec.space. The backup at ded-sec.online is intended for continuity if the main domain or hosting path becomes unavailable. Repository-aware builds keep their domain and path rules separate.

Which Repository Contains The Main Website Source?

The main website repository is dedsec1121fk/dedsec1121fk.github.io. The sal-scar/ded-sec repository is the backup mirror, while dedsec1121fk/test is used to review changes before production.

How Do I Update An Existing DedSec Project Installation?

Follow the Update guide in Assistance or the repository README. Back up changed settings, personal data and custom scripts before pulling or replacing files, because project updates may change filenames or structure.

Will An Update Overwrite My Modifications?

It can if you replace the full project folder. Keep personal changes in a separate branch or backup, compare changes with Git and merge intentionally instead of copying blindly.

Where Should I Report A Bug?

Use the project’s Contact page or the relevant GitHub repository issue tracker. Include the exact script, commit or version, Android version, Termux source, architecture, complete command and complete error output with secrets removed.

Can I Contribute Code, Translations Or Testing?

Yes. Small focused pull requests are easier to review. Explain what changed, how it was tested in Termux, which files are affected and any safety or compatibility limitations.

Why Does The Test Repository Have Different Links?

GitHub project pages for Test run below /Test/, while the main and backup domains run at the root. The repository-aware build rewrites internal paths, canonical URLs, CNAME and indexing files for the selected target.

Looking For Termux Error Fixes?

Use Assistance for free focused fixes. Optional GitHub Sponsors tiers are $3, $9 and $25; the $25 Ultimate Supporter tier includes the current five-ebook library in English and Greek.

### Guide For Installation [en]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/Pages/guide-for-installation.html

Guide For Installation

Step-by-step instructions to install and set up the DedSec Project on Termux for Android, Ubuntu, Kali Linux, or Linux Mint.

Requirements

Supported system: Termux on Android, Ubuntu, Kali Linux, or Linux Mint.

Storage: Minimum 6GB free space for the DedSec Project installation.

RAM: Minimum 2GB.

Internet: Required for the first installation and for updates.

Storage warning: The 6GB requirement covers the DedSec Project installation itself. Scripts that capture or save additional content—such as photos, screenshots, videos, recordings, logs, downloads, or other generated files—can require extra storage beyond the 6GB project requirement.

Installation time: A complete installation can take approximately 20–50 minutes, depending on your internet connection and your device's processor.

Choose Your Platform

Tap your platform to open the installation instructions.

Termux (Android)

Install Termux & Add-Ons

To install APKs such as F-Droid, enable installation from unknown apps for your browser or file manager in Android settings.

1. Install F-Droid

F-Droid is the recommended source for Termux and its add-ons.

Download F-Droid

Download the F-Droid APK from the link above.

Open Android Settings, then Security or Apps & Notifications.

Allow your browser or file manager to install unknown apps.

Open the downloaded APK and tap Install.

Open F-Droid and install Termux.

For the full Android feature set, install Termux and the supported add-ons from F-Droid.

Copypkg update -y && pkg upgrade -y && pkg install git nano -y && termux-setup-storage

Copygit clone https://github.com/dedsec1121fk/DedSec

Copycd DedSec && bash Setup.sh

Learn About The Tools

This page is the map of the project: what each tool does, why it exists, and what real problem pushed me to build it. Start with the list, follow what catches your eye, and let the tools explain the project by themselves.

Cross-Platform Tool Support

DedSec now uses the same launcher on Termux, Ubuntu, Kali Linux, and Linux Mint. Portable tools use Linux-aware paths; Android-specific utilities remain Termux-only and are clearly marked below.

Termux: native packages and Android storage such as ~/storage/downloads/.

Ubuntu / Kali Linux / Linux Mint: project-local .venv, Compat/bin, and desktop Downloads paths such as ~/Downloads/.

Always start the project with ./Run.sh after running bash Setup.sh.

Termux Repair Wizard.py

What It Helps With

Diagnosing common Termux setup/package problems through a guided repair flow instead of trying random commands.

DedSec Termux Repair Wizard is a no-root diagnostic and repair suite for repository and mirror errors, apt/dpkg failures, storage access, permissions, TLS certificates, caches, Python/pip, and shell/PATH problems. Its Script Keeper scans one script or an entire folder without directly launching the scripts, recognizes more than 20 languages plus extensionless shebang files, checks syntax, runtimes, commands, imports, modules, and common project manifests, and can install missing Termux and language-specific dependencies after confirmation. For newer Python releases, it also tries compatible replacement packages for removed standard-library modules. Every Script Keeper run produces a categorized report of installed items, fixes, warnings, failures, and syntax issues.

Save Location

Most repairs are applied directly to Termux packages, storage permissions, $HOME permissions, and shell files such as ~/.bashrc, ~/.profile, and ~/.zshrc. Script Keeper reports are saved as ~/DedSec/logs/script_keeper_<timestamp>.log.

Platform Support & Save Paths

Platform support: Termux only. This utility manages Android/Termux-specific features and is not applied to desktop Linux.

Termux: Most repairs are applied directly to Termux packages, storage permissions, $HOME permissions, and shell files such as ~/.bashrc, ~/.profile, and ~/.zshrc. Script Keeper reports are saved as ~/DedSec/logs/script_keeper_<timestamp>.log.

Ubuntu: Not applicable — this utility manages Android/Termux-specific features.

Kali Linux: Not applicable — this utility manages Android/Termux-specific features.

Linux Mint: Not applicable — this utility manages Android/Termux-specific features.

Personal Information Capture

Fake Back Camera Page

What It Helps With

Running authorized awareness demonstrations that show how deceptive pages may request camera access, so permission prompts and social-engineering risks are easier to recognize.

Fake Back Camera Page is a consent-based awareness demo for teaching how deceptive permission prompts can pressure people into sharing sensitive access around Back Camera. Use it only in a lab, with dummy data, screenshots, or clear permission from participants. It is not presented as a tool for stealing information.

Save Location

Captured back-camera images and related text data are saved in ~/storage/downloads/Camera-Phish-Back/.

Platform Support & Save Paths

Platform support: available in the Termux build; desktop compatibility mode intentionally leaves this module disabled.

Termux: Captured back-camera images and related text data are saved in ~/storage/downloads/Camera-Phish-Back/.

Ubuntu: Not enabled by the desktop compatibility launcher; the documented Termux/lab save path remains unchanged.

Kali Linux: Not enabled by the desktop compatibility launcher; the documented Termux/lab save path remains unchanged.

Linux Mint: Not enabled by the desktop compatibility launcher; the documented Termux/lab save path remains unchanged.

Settings.py

What It Helps With

Managing DedSec Project maintenance and launching a complete browser-native desktop with advanced files, documents, media, terminal, packages, personalization, security, and troubleshooting tools from one central Settings.py experience.

Settings.py is the central control panel for the DedSec Project and the launcher for DedSec OS. The terminal settings menus cover project/device information, main and backup-source updates, package/module refreshes, Sponsors-Only access, Save DedSec Project, the privacy-filtered offline Transfer System, prompt settings, GitHub connection/stats, Termux usage stats, HTTP Proxy & Tor utilities, menu style and auto-start, language, credits, and uninstall. DedSec OS adds a Windows-style local desktop with movable/resizable windows, Start/taskbar/Action Center, File Explorer and shared Open/Save dialogs, Recycle Bin, Notepad, Web Office, Word/Excel/PowerPoint/PDF Explorer, Photo Studio, Video Editor, media/gallery/camera/recorder tools, Archive Manager, Calendar, Maps, browser, Terminal, Applications, Software Center, utilities, games, personalization, login/optional 2FA/password recovery, and a full Help & Troubleshooting app with guided fixes and live diagnostics. Built-in browser apps are designed to work without X11; optional legacy X11 programs remain available separately.

Face Detector.py

What It Helps With

Experimenting with face detection on permitted images or camera input as a sponsor-only computer-vision tool.

Local browser-based face analysis tool for Termux that works without root. It uses MediaPipe Face Mesh on the live camera feed, supports both front and back camera, tracks up to 3 faces, draws detailed facial landmark overlays instead of simple boxes, and also lets you upload photos or videos for analysis directly from the interface. It can capture PNG snapshots, record WEBM video, save cropped detected faces separately, and provide both a local network link and an optional Cloudflare public link.

Save Location

On Termux, captures, recordings, uploaded results, and saved face crops are stored in: ~/storage/downloads/Face Detector/. If Termux storage is unavailable, it falls back to ~/Face Detector/. On non-Termux systems it uses ~/Downloads/Face Detector/, with fallback to ~/Face Detector/. Internal web files, certificates, and helper binaries are stored in ~/.face_detector_studio/.

Face Detector Heavy.py

What It Helps With

Running a heavier face-detection workflow when you need more processing options and your device can handle the extra load.

Expanded heavy-analysis version of the face detector for Termux, built without root. Along with live camera use, front/back camera switching, photo and video uploads, PNG snapshots, WEBM recording, and saved face crops, it raises tracking up to 30 faces and adds TensorFlow COCO-SSD object detection on top of the MediaPipe face mesh pipeline. It shows richer on-screen telemetry such as face count, animal/object detection, pose and gaze estimates, facial proportions, mouth and brow state, asymmetry scoring, and other visual analysis details, while still supporting both a local network link and an optional Cloudflare public link.

Face Swap.py

What It Helps With

Testing face-swap image transformation on media you have permission to use.

Local browser-based face swap tool for Termux that works without root. It opens a local camera page, lets you upload a source face image, switch between the front and back camera, and blend the uploaded face over the live camera using MediaPipe Face Mesh. The current version focuses on a smooth face-lock approach: it locks the uploaded face once, follows the live face, moves key feature patches for expressions, includes smoothing, feathering, opacity, blend, and skin-tone matching controls, and can save PNG snapshots from the browser. Use it only with your own images or with clear permission.

Save Location

On Termux, saved photos are stored in: /storage/emulated/0/Download/Face Swap/ or ~/storage/downloads/Face Swap/, with fallback to ~/Face Swap/. On non-Termux systems it uses ~/Downloads/Face Swap/, with fallback to ~/Face Swap/.

Ubuntu: On Termux, saved photos are stored in: ~/Downloads/Face Swap/ or ~/Downloads/Face Swap/, with fallback to ~/Face Swap/. On non-Termux systems it uses ~/Downloads/Face Swap/, with fallback to ~/Face Swap/.

Kali Linux: On Termux, saved photos are stored in: ~/Downloads/Face Swap/ or ~/Downloads/Face Swap/, with fallback to ~/Face Swap/. On non-Termux systems it uses ~/Downloads/Face Swap/, with fallback to ~/Face Swap/.

Linux Mint: On Termux, saved photos are stored in: ~/Downloads/Face Swap/ or ~/Downloads/Face Swap/, with fallback to ~/Face Swap/. On non-Termux systems it uses ~/Downloads/Face Swap/, with fallback to ~/Face Swap/.

Steganography.py

What It Helps With

Learning how data can be hidden in and recovered from files for authorized security and forensic practice.

Password-based steganography suite for Termux. It can generate random black-and-white PNG carrier images, encrypt secret text with a password-derived Fernet key, hide the encrypted text inside PNG images using LSB steganography, and batch-decode hidden messages from all images placed in the Decrypt folder. Extracted messages are automatically saved as separate .txt files, and the script can also optionally clean processed images from the decode folder after scanning.

Save Location

Main folder: /storage/emulated/0/Download/Steganography/ | Carrier/output images: /Encrypt | Images to scan for hidden messages: /Decrypt | Extracted text files: /Decrypted Texts.

Platform Support & Save Paths

Platform support: documented for Termux, Ubuntu, Kali Linux, and Linux Mint. Use the platform path that matches your system.

Termux: Main folder: /storage/emulated/0/Download/Steganography/ | Carrier/output images: /Encrypt | Images to scan for hidden messages: /Decrypt | Extracted text files: /Decrypted Texts.

Widget Maker.py

What It Helps With

Creating reusable phone/Termux widgets so common commands or project actions are easier to launch.

DedSec Widget Maker is a no-root Termux helper that creates Android home-screen launchers for DedSec Project scripts through Termux:Widget. It recursively scans Termux home, shared storage, and common phone folders for DedSec, sponsor, exclusive, and related Python scripts, including scripts inside every accessible folder and subfolder. It then creates managed shortcuts in ~/.shortcuts. Each widget opens a small menu with Run, Show Script Path, and Exit, validates the Python file before launching it, keeps a manifest in ~/.dedsec_widget_maker/, and can update or delete all managed widgets when your script collection changes.

to operate, secure, and maintain the website and related services,.

### DedSec Linux venv & Paths [el]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/el/Assistance/dedsec-linux-venv-paths.html

DedSec Linux venv & Paths

Κατανόησε το Linux environment και τα file locations που χρησιμοποιεί το DedSec ώστε να κάνεις troubleshooting χωρίς λάθος αλλαγές.

Γρήγορη Περίληψη

Κατανόησε το Linux environment και τα file locations που χρησιμοποιεί το DedSec ώστε να κάνεις troubleshooting χωρίς λάθος αλλαγές.

Project Environment

Το desktop Linux χρησιμοποιεί τοπικό .venv μέσα στο DedSec repository. Τρέξε ./Run.sh αντί να αναμειγνύεις global Python packages με το project.

Έλεγχος Environment

cd ~/DedSec pwd ./.venv/bin/python --version printf "%s\n" "$PATH"

Compatibility Layer

Το Compat/bin παρέχει desktop-safe replacements ή shims για commands που περιμένουν portable scripts. Το Run.sh το προσθέτει αυτόματα.

Downloads

Τα portable εργαλεία συνήθως αποθηκεύουν στο ~/Downloads/ σε Ubuntu, Kali Linux και Linux Mint. Τα ακριβή paths ανά εργαλείο βρίσκονται στη σελίδα Μάθε Για Τα Εργαλεία.

Shell Files

Ubuntu και Linux Mint συνήθως χρησιμοποιούν ~/.bashrc. Το Kali μπορεί να χρησιμοποιεί ~/.zshrc. Το Termux χρησιμοποιεί $PREFIX/etc/bash.bashrc.

Επόμενα Βήματα

Για platform-specific save paths, δες τη σελίδα Μάθε Για Τα Εργαλεία. Για γενικά προβλήματα, επέστρεψε στη Βοήθεια.

Μάθε Για Τα ΕργαλείαΌλοι Οι Οδηγοί Βοήθειας


### Επιδιόρθωση Χαλασμένης Εγκατάστασης Του DedSec [el]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/el/Assistance/fix-dedsec-broken-install.html

Επιδιόρθωση Χαλασμένης Εγκατάστασης Του DedSec

Διάγνωσε εγκατάσταση DedSec Project σε Termux ή υποστηριζόμενα Linux desktops όταν modules, paths, updates, environments ή storage σταματήσουν να λειτουργούν.

Σύντομη Απάντηση

Διάγνωσε μια εγκατάσταση του DedSec Project που σταμάτησε να λειτουργεί λόγω ελλιπών modules, λάθος φακέλου, αποτυχημένης ενημέρωσης ή προβλήματος αποθήκευσης.

Χρησιμοποίησε αυτόν τον οδηγό μόνο όταν το σύμπτωμα ή ο στόχος ταιριάζει με τις ενδείξεις παρακάτω. Αν μια διαγνωστική εντολή δείξει διαφορετικό πρόβλημα, ακολούθησε αυτή την ένδειξη αντί να εκτελέσεις μηχανικά όλα τα βήματα.

Τελευταίος έλεγχος: 24 Ιουλίου 2026.

Χρησιμοποίησε Τον Οδηγό Όταν Βλέπεις

BrokenDedSecInstall

Πριν Εκτελέσεις Οτιδήποτε

Κράτησε backup προσωπικών ρυθμίσεων, outputs, τροποποιημένων scripts και αποθηκευμένων δεδομένων πριν από επανεγκατάσταση ή ενημέρωση.

Επιβεβαίωσε τον ακριβή φάκελο DedSec και την κατάσταση Git αντί να κάνεις νέο clone μέσα στον υπάρχοντα φάκελο.

Κράτησε ολόκληρο το πρώτο σφάλμα αντί να αντικαταστήσεις αμέσως όλη την εγκατάσταση.

Εντολές Ελέγχου Ή Ρύθμισης

Κράτησε πρώτα backup των προσωπικών ρυθμίσεων και outputs του DedSec. Επιβεβαίωσε τον τρέχοντα φάκελο DedSec πριν αντιγράψεις ή εκτελέσεις το block.

Αντιγραφή εντολών

pwd ls python -m py_compile script.py python script.py

Τι Δείχνουν Οι Εντολές

`pwd` — Εμφανίζει τον τρέχοντα φάκελο εργασίας.

`ls` — Εμφανίζει αρχεία, ονόματα και δικαιώματα.

`python -m py_compile script.py` — Ελέγχει τη σύνταξη Python χωρίς να ξεκινήσει ολόκληρο το πρόγραμμα.

Πώς Φαίνεται Ότι Λύθηκε

Ο σωστός launcher του DedSec ξεκινά από τον φάκελο που αναφέρει ο οδηγός.

Οι προσωπικές ρυθμίσεις και τα αποθηκευμένα outputs παραμένουν μετά την επισκευή ή ενημέρωση.

Μια δεύτερη εκκίνηση λειτουργεί χωρίς επανάληψη της εγκατάστασης.

Ασφαλή Επόμενα Βήματα

Εντόπισε αν η αποτυχία αφορά φάκελο, εξάρτηση, Git, δικαιώματα ή αποθηκευμένα δεδομένα.

Επισκεύασε μόνο αυτό το επίπεδο και δοκίμασε το μικρότερο entry point του DedSec.

Σύγκρινε τα αλλαγμένα αρχεία πριν αντικαταστήσεις τοπικές τροποποιήσεις.

Κράτησε χρονολογημένο backup αφού επιβεβαιώσεις ότι η επισκευασμένη έκδοση ξεκινά σωστά.

Συνηθισμένα Λάθη

Διαγραφή του υπάρχοντος φακέλου DedSec πριν αντιγραφούν ρυθμίσεις και outputs.

Δημιουργία επαναλαμβανόμενων nested clones όπως `DedSec/DedSec/DedSec`.

Εκτέλεση εντολής αντικατάστασης από λάθος γλώσσα ή φάκελο project.

Διόρθωση Ελέγχου Ταυτότητας GitHub Μέσω SSH Στο Termux

Ρύθμισε την ταυτοποίηση GitHub στο Termux με HTTPS token ή κλειδί SSH, χωρίς να τη συγχέεις με τον κανονικό κωδικό του λογαριασμού σου.

Σύντομη Απάντηση

Ρύθμισε την ταυτοποίηση GitHub στο Termux με HTTPS token ή κλειδί SSH, χωρίς να τη συγχέεις με τον κανονικό κωδικό του λογαριασμού σου.

Χρησιμοποίησε αυτόν τον οδηγό μόνο όταν το σύμπτωμα ή ο στόχος ταιριάζει με τις ενδείξεις παρακάτω. Αν μια διαγνωστική εντολή δείξει διαφορετικό πρόβλημα, ακολούθησε αυτή την ένδειξη αντί να εκτελέσεις μηχανικά όλα τα βήματα.

Αφαίρεσε tokens, ιδιωτικά κλειδιά και προσωπικές διαδρομές από output που θα κοινοποιήσεις.

pkg install openssh git -y ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "you@example.com" cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub ssh -T git@github.com

Το remote δείχνει στο σωστό repository και η ταυτοποίηση πετυχαίνει χωρίς έκθεση στοιχείων σύνδεσης.

Το push περιέχει μόνο τα αρχεία που περίμενες.

Ασφαλή Επόμενα Βήματα

Χρησιμοποίησε τη λιγότερο καταστροφική ενέργεια που λύνει το ακριβές μήνυμα του Git.

Έλεγξε diff και staged αρχεία πριν από commit ή push.

Επαλήθευσε το αποτέλεσμα στο GitHub μετά την ολοκλήρωση του push.

Συνηθισμένα Λάθη

Χρήση force push, reset ή αλλαγής ιστορικού χωρίς επαληθευμένο backup.

### Ο Τοπικός Server Δεν Ανοίγει Στο Android [el]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/el/Assistance/fix-localhost-server-not-opening-android.html

Ο Τοπικός Server Δεν Ανοίγει Στο Android

Διόρθωσε έναν τοπικό server που δεν ανοίγει στον browser, ελέγχοντας τη διεύθυνση σύνδεσης, το port, τον φάκελο, τη συμπεριφορά του Android και το σωστό URL.

Σύντομη Απάντηση

Διόρθωσε έναν τοπικό server που δεν ανοίγει στον browser, ελέγχοντας τη διεύθυνση σύνδεσης, το port, τον φάκελο, τη συμπεριφορά του Android και το σωστό URL.

Χρησιμοποίησε αυτόν τον οδηγό μόνο όταν το σύμπτωμα ή ο στόχος ταιριάζει με τις ενδείξεις παρακάτω. Αν μια διαγνωστική εντολή δείξει διαφορετικό πρόβλημα, ακολούθησε αυτή την ένδειξη αντί να εκτελέσεις μηχανικά όλα τα βήματα.

Τελευταίος έλεγχος: 24 Ιουλίου 2026.

Χρησιμοποίησε Τον Οδηγό Όταν Βλέπεις

Connection refusedThis site can’t be reachedERR_CONNECTION_REFUSED

Πριν Εκτελέσεις Οτιδήποτε

Ξεκίνησε τον server στο προσκήνιο και κράτησε ορατό το output του τερματικού.

Επιβεβαίωσε host, port, φάκελο που σερβίρεται και URL πριν ανοίξεις τον browser.

Έκθεσε μόνο ειδικό δημόσιο φάκελο· ποτέ το Termux home, κλειδιά, backups ή ιδιωτικά repositories.

Εντολές Ελέγχου Ή Ρύθμισης

Αντικατάστησε το ενδεικτικό port και τον φάκελο. Δοκίμασε πρώτα το τοπικό URL στο ίδιο κινητό πριν δημιουργήσεις διεύθυνση LAN ή δημόσιο tunnel.

Αντιγραφή εντολών

pwd python -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1 # open http://127.0.0.1:8080 in the same phone browser

Τι Δείχνουν Οι Εντολές

`pwd` — Εμφανίζει τον τρέχοντα φάκελο εργασίας.

`python -m http.server 8080 --bind 127.0.0.1` — Ξεκινά απλό τοπικό HTTP server στον τρέχοντα φάκελο.

Πώς Φαίνεται Ότι Λύθηκε

Το τοπικό URL ανοίγει στο ίδιο κινητό και το τερματικό καταγράφει το request.

Το refresh εμφανίζει τα τρέχοντα αρχεία και όχι παλιό cached περιεχόμενο.

Με το σταμάτημα του server ελευθερώνεται το port και κλείνει κάθε προσωρινό δημόσιο tunnel.

Ασφαλή Επόμενα Βήματα

Επαλήθευσε πρώτα τοπικά τη διεργασία και τον φάκελο που σερβίρεται.

Έλεγξε αν άλλη διεργασία χρησιμοποιεί ήδη το port.

Χρησιμοποίησε `127.0.0.1` για δοκιμή στο ίδιο κινητό και σκόπιμη bind address για LAN.

Δημιούργησε δημόσιο tunnel μόνο αφού λειτουργήσει το τοπικό URL και αφαιρέσεις μυστικά από τον δημόσιο φάκελο.

Συνηθισμένα Λάθη

Άνοιγμα λάθος port ή υπόθεση ότι το `localhost` άλλης συσκευής δείχνει στο κινητό.

Εκκίνηση πολλών background servers χωρίς καταγραφή των process IDs.

Δημοσίευση credentials, source repositories, backups ή ολόκληρου του Termux home μέσω tunnel.

Χρειάζεσαι Ακόμη Βοήθεια;

Αντέγραψε την αναφορά υποστήριξης, συμπλήρωσε τα στοιχεία και πρόσθεσε ολόκληρο το output του τερματικού. Αφαίρεσε κωδικούς, tokens, ιδιωτικά κλειδιά, ακριβείς προσωπικές διαδρομές και προσωπικά στοιχεία.

### Διόρθωση Σφαλμάτων Node.js Και npm Στο Termux [el]

Source-URL: https://ded-sec.space/el/Assistance/fix-node-npm-errors-termux.html

Διόρθωση Σφαλμάτων Node.js Και npm Στο Termux

Διόρθωσε σφάλματα όπως «npm command not found», αποτυχίες node-gyp, προβλήματα εγκατάστασης πακέτων και χαλασμένα JavaScript projects στο Termux.

Σύντομη Απάντηση

Διόρθωσε σφάλματα όπως «npm command not found», αποτυχίες node-gyp, προβλήματα εγκατάστασης πακέτων και χαλασμένα JavaScript projects στο Termux.

Χρησιμοποίησε αυτόν τον οδηγό μόνο όταν το σύμπτωμα ή ο στόχος ταιριάζει με τις ενδείξεις παρακάτω. Αν μια διαγνωστική εντολή δείξει διαφορετικό πρόβλημα, ακολούθησε αυτή την ένδειξη αντί να εκτελέσεις μηχανικά όλα τα βήματα.

Τελευταίος έλεγχος: 24 Ιουλίου 2026.

Χρησιμοποίησε Τον Οδηγό Όταν Βλέπεις

npm ERR!node-gypERESOLVEMODULE_NOT_FOUND

Πριν Εκτελέσεις Οτιδήποτε

Αντέγραψε ολόκληρο το σφάλμα, μαζί με το πρώτο πακέτο, αρχείο, module ή αριθμό γραμμής που αναφέρει.

Κατέγραψε το `termux-info`, την ενεργή έκδοση του runtime και τον τρέχοντα φάκελο πριν αλλάξεις εξαρτήσεις.

Μη διαγράφεις locks του διαχειριστή πακέτων και μην αναβαθμίζεις το ίδιο το pip μέσω pip στο Termux.

Εντολές Ελέγχου Ή Ρύθμισης

Κράτησε το `package-lock.json`, εκτός αν θέλεις σκόπιμα να αλλάξεις εκδόσεις εξαρτήσεων. Χρησιμοποίησε `npm ci` όταν το αρχείο κλειδώματος είναι έγκυρο.

Αντιγραφή εντολών

pkg update pkg install -y nodejs python make clang node -v npm -v npm cache verify test -f package-lock.json && npm ci || npm install

Τι Δείχνουν Οι Εντολές

`pkg update` — Ανανεώνει το ευρετήριο πακέτων του Termux.

`pkg install -y nodejs python make clang` — Εγκαθιστά τα αναφερόμενα πακέτα του Termux και τις εξαρτήσεις τους.

`npm cache verify` — Ελέγχει την cache του npm χωρίς διαγραφή του dependency lock file.

Πώς Φαίνεται Ότι Λύθηκε

Η ελάχιστη δοκιμή έκδοσης, import, σύνταξης, διαδρομής ή πακέτου ολοκληρώνεται επιτυχώς.

Η αρχική εντολή πλέον ολοκληρώνεται ή σταματά αργότερα για διαφορετικό και σαφώς αναγνωρισμένο λόγο.

Δεν παραμένει διακοπείσα ρύθμιση πακέτων σε εκκρεμότητα.

Ασφαλή Επόμενα Βήματα

Επισκεύασε ή ενημέρωσε πρώτα το επίπεδο πακέτων του Termux.

Επιβεβαίωσε ότι ο interpreter και το εργαλείο πακέτων ανήκουν στην ίδια εγκατάσταση.

Εγκατέστησε την εξάρτηση συστήματος που λείπει πριν επαναλάβεις build Python ή Node.

Κάνε νέα δοκιμή με εντολή έκδοσης, import, compile ή αρχείου πριν τρέξεις ολόκληρο το script.

Συνηθισμένα Λάθη

Χρήση `sudo`, ονομάτων πακέτων Ubuntu ή διαδρομών υπολογιστή σε κανονικό Termux.

Υπόθεση ότι το όνομα import είναι πάντα ίδιο με το όνομα διανομής στο PyPI.

Διαγραφή cache, environments ή lock files πριν αποθηκευτούν το ακριβές σφάλμα και οι εκδόσεις.

Χρειάζεσαι Ακόμη Βοήθεια;

Αντέγραψε την αναφορά υποστήριξης, συμπλήρωσε τα στοιχεία και πρόσθεσε ολόκληρο το output του τερματικού. Αφαίρεσε κωδικούς, tokens, ιδιωτικά κλειδιά, ακριβείς προσωπικές διαδρομές και προσωπικά στοιχεία.

Σύντομη Απάντηση

Ξεχώρισε προβλήματα του pip, αποτυχίες build, ελλιπή wheels, σφάλματα compiler και εξαρτήσεις του Termux πριν εγκαταστήσεις βιβλιοθήκες Python.

Χρησιμοποίησε αυτόν τον οδηγό μόνο όταν το σύμπτωμα ή ο στόχος ταιριάζει με τις ενδείξεις παρακάτω. Αν μια διαγνωστική εντολή δείξει διαφορετικό πρόβλημα, ακολούθησε αυτή την ένδειξη αντί να εκτελέσεις μηχανικά όλα τα βήματα.

Τελευταίος έλεγχος: 24 Ιουλίου 2026.

Χρησιμοποίησε Τον Οδηγό Όταν Βλέπεις

Installing pip is forbiddenFailed building wheelsubprocess-exited-with-errorNo matching distribution found

Πριν Εκτελέσεις Οτιδήποτε

Αντέγραψε ολόκληρο το σφάλμα, μαζί με το πρώτο πακέτο, αρχείο, module ή αριθμό γραμμής που αναφέρει.

Κατέγραψε το `termux-info`, την ενεργή έκδοση του runtime και τον τρέχοντα φάκελο πριν αλλάξεις εξαρτήσεις.

Μη διαγράφεις locks του διαχειριστή πακέτων και μην αναβαθμίζεις το ίδιο το pip μέσω pip στο Termux.

Εντολές Ελέγχου Ή Ρύθμισης

Το Termux διαχειρίζεται το pip μέσω του `python-pip`. Μην εκτελείς `pip install --upgrade pip`· ενημέρωσέ το με `pkg upgrade python-pip`.

Αντιγραφή εντολών

pkg update pkg install -y python python-pip python -m pip --version python -m pip install --upgrade setuptools wheel python -m pip install PACKAGE_NAME

Τι Δείχνουν Οι Εντολές

`pkg update` — Ανανεώνει το ευρετήριο πακέτων του Termux.

`pkg install -y python python-pip` — Εγκαθιστά τα αναφερόμενα πακέτα του Termux και τις εξαρτήσεις τους.

`python -m pip --version` — Εμφανίζει ποιο pip ανήκει στην ενεργή Python.

`python -m pip install --upgrade setuptools wheel` — Εγκαθιστά ή ενημερώνει τη συγκεκριμένη διανομή Python, όχι το ίδιο το pip.

Πώς Φαίνεται Ότι Λύθηκε

Η ελάχιστη δοκιμή έκδοσης, import, σύνταξης, διαδρομής ή πακέτου ολοκληρώνεται επιτυχώς.

Η αρχική εντολή πλέον ολοκληρώνεται ή σταματά αργότερα για διαφορετικό και σαφώς αναγνωρισμένο λόγο.

Δεν παραμένει διακοπείσα ρύθμιση πακέτων σε εκκρεμότητα.

Ασφαλή Επόμενα Βήματα

Επισκεύασε ή ενημέρωσε πρώτα το επίπεδο πακέτων του Termux.

Επιβεβαίωσε ότι ο interpreter και το εργαλείο πακέτων ανήκουν στην ίδια εγκατάσταση.

Εγκατέστησε την εξάρτηση συστήματος που λείπει πριν επαναλάβεις build Python ή Node.

Κάνε νέα δοκιμή με εντολή έκδοσης, import, compile ή αρχείου πριν τρέξεις ολόκληρο το script.

Συνηθισμένα Λάθη

Χρήση `sudo`, ονομάτων πακέτων Ubuntu ή διαδρομών υπολογιστή σε κανονικό Termux.

Υπόθεση ότι το όνομα import είναι πάντα ίδιο με το όνομα διανομής στο PyPI.

Διαγραφή cache, environments ή lock files πριν αποθηκευτούν το ακριβές σφάλμα και οι εκδόσεις.

Χρειάζεσαι Ακόμη Βοήθεια;
